title: Website hero and product transition
slide_intent: Connect an opening message to a product view so movement helps a viewer follow the offer.
strategic_value: O2 can make a website feel continuous with its brand animation by carrying the bubble and gradient into the sales page.
demonstration: A browser mockup begins with a centered headline over moving bubbles, then shifts to phones held at left and a product headline at right as the lower gradient warms.
practical_value: Keep navigation stable while moving from a brand-led hero to a more specific product composition.

content_islands.name: Browser frame and navigation
content_islands.spec: Center the desktop browser on a dark surround and retain the small O2 mark and navigation across the top.

content_islands.name: Opening hero
content_islands.spec: Center white headline and supporting copy over the blue gradient and bubbles.

content_islands.name: Product reveal
content_islands.spec: Introduce the large phones at left and move the sales message to the right against a warmer lower field.

reference_purposes.Expression: The blue gradient, soft bubbles and white rounded type carry through the sequence.
reference_purposes.Application: The brand ingredients appear in a desktop website hero and product transition.
